programme.desc: Sir András Schiff leitet das Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet der Hochschule für Musik Reina Sofía. Auf dem Programm steht Bachs Konzert für Cembalo Nr. 5 in f-Moll, BWV 1056 sowie Mendelssohns Sinfonie Nr. 4 in A-Dur, Op. 90, die Italienische.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin
programme.desc: Für Freunde und Musiker war und ist die Schweizer Klaviervirtuosin Clara Haskil eine Interpretin, die wie keine andere Maßstäbe gesetzt hat. Anhand von Klaviereinspielungen, Briefen und Interviews zeigt der Film die Musikerin in neuem Licht.

programme.title: Dvorák - Sinfonie Nr. 8 in G-Dur, op. 88

programme.desc: A look at 'The Legacy of Farinelli' and following the history of castrati in choral music: male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14
programme.desc: Evgeny Kissin enchants with a magnificent piano recital of works by Chopin, Schumann, and Debussy at the 25th anniversary edition of the Swiss Verbier Festival in 2018, on the centennial of Debussy's death.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energising concert pieces featuring a range of artists.

programme.title: Mahler, Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra; conductor: Fabio Luisi. Recorded at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Dialogue between Zubin Mehta and the musicians as they explore Strauss' tone poem together.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta

programme.title: Dvorák, Slavonic Dance, Op. 46 No. 8
programme.desc: The Los Angeles Philharmonic, conducted by Zubin Mehta, plays the `Slavonic Dance, Op 46 No 8' by Antonín Dvorák. This recording was made in January 1977 at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion, Los Angeles.

programme.title: Schumann - Novellettes, op. 21
programme.desc: The celebrated Italian pianist, Riccardo Schwartz, decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann's work, Novelletten, Op 21.

programme.title: Bach
programme.desc: Johann Sebastian Bach craved a career change in 1721. Wishing to join the court of Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg, Bach presented him with six new concertos in the hopes of securing a position.

programme.title: Mozart, Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338
programme.desc: The Mozarteum Orchestra Salzburg perform Mozart's `Symphony No 34 in C major, K. 338'.

programme.title: Penderecki - Symphony No. 7: 7 Gates of Jerusalem
programme.desc: The 2017 Prague Spring festival is brought to a powerful close as Krzysztof Penderecki conducts the Prague Radio Symphony Orchestra and Slovak Philharmonic Choir in a performance of his monumental seventh symphony Seven Gates of Jerusalem.

programme.title: Beethoven
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado conducts the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's `Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125' to commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra's founding on 1 May 1882.

programme.title: Luisi Conducts Strauss, Beethoven & Schoenberg
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Strauss' Horn Concerto No. 1. This work is one of the most popular and frequently performed horn concertos written in the 19th century.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Quintet in E-flat major, Op. 44
programme.desc: The concert pays tribute to the cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin who passed away on May 13, 2023. Martha Argerich, Tedi Papavrami and Yossif Ivanov, Lyda Chen-Argerich, and Jing Zhao perform Robert Schumann's

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
Bruckner
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the Philharmonie Zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner's Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Beethoven Piano Concerto No. 1 & Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Pianist Martha Argerich performs Ludwig van Beethoven's `Piano Concerto No 1' and `Symphony No 2' at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt.

programme.title: Schumann: Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: Schwarz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece's title refers to humour as an emotional state.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C Minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Les Dissonances perform Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed Symphony No 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work at nearly the same time as his Symphony No 6, 'Pastorale'.

programme.title: Donizetti, Don Pasquale
programme.desc: From the Teatro Filarmonico di Verona: Don Pasquale by Donizetti. Conductor: Omer Meir Wellber.

programme.title: In Rehearsal
programme.desc: Esa-Pekka Salonen rehearses Debussy's

programme.title: Verdi, Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Giuseppe Verdi (1813-1901): Messa da Requiem. Chorus & Orchestra of the Teatro alla Scala, Milan; conductor: Daniel Barenboim.

programme.title: Chopin, Fantasy in F Minor, Op. 49
programme.desc: Krystian Zimerman plays `Fantasy in F minor, Op. 49' by Frédéric Chopin.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energising concert pieces featuring a range of artists.

programme.title: Schumann - Kreisleriana, op. 16
programme.desc: Contrasting sections invoke the imaginary musician's violent mood swings as well as the conflict between Schumann's own two fictional characters, Florestan and Eusebius, which represent the duality of the composer's own personality.

programme.title: Beethoven Violin Concerto & Bizet Symphony in C
programme.desc: Young Venezuelan conductor Glass Marcano is a rising star. Having played in various local youth and symphony orchestras as a violinist, her first experience conducting an ensemble followed in 2012.

programme.title: Liszt : Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: The pianist duo Marco Sollini and Salvatore Barbatano perform several compositions by Franz Liszt. This performance was given in the Church of San Marco, in the heart of the village of Ponzano di Fermo in the Marche region, Italy.

programme.title: Hans van Manen Festival
programme.desc: A celebration of the works of choreographer Hans van Manen for his 75th birthday. International guest artists, including Uliana Lopatkina and Lucia Lacarra, perform some of van Manen's most celebrated ballets.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26
programme.desc: Schwarz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna). Schumann composed most of the work during his stay in Vienna in 1839, where he wrote the first four movements.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energising concert pieces featuring a range of artists.

programme.title: Mahler: Symphony No.8
programme.desc: Gustavo Dudamel and his Simón Bolívar Symphony Orchestra perform Mahler to mark the highlight of the residency of El Sistema at the Salzburg Festival.

programme.title: Works by Mendelssohn and Hensel
programme.desc: Bashkirova is joined by soprano Juliane Banse, flutist Emmanuel Pahud, cellist Claudio Bohórquez, clarinettist Karl-Heinz Steffens, and pianist Ohad Ben-Ari in a chamber music program dedicated to the music of Mendelssohn and his sister Fanny Hensel.

programme.title: Works by Mendelssohn and Hensel
programme.desc: Bashkirova is joined by soprano Juliane Banse, flutist Emmanuel Pahud, cellist Claudio Bohórquez, clarinettist Karl-Heinz Steffens, and pianist Ohad Ben-Ari in a chamber music program dedicated to the music of Mendelssohn and his sister Fanny Hensel.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: A portrait of the composer Charles Ives. Ives was among the first American composers to achieve international acclaim. Born in 1874, he experimented with advanced features including polytonality, twelve-tone technique, and quarter tones.

programme.title: Schubert - Overture to Rosamunde (D. 644)
programme.desc: Andreas Spering conducts Philharmonie Zuidnederland in a performance of Overture Rosamunde (D. 644), by Franz Schubert (1797-1828).

programme.title: Mahler -- Symphony No. 2 (Resurrection)
programme.desc: Recorded at the Rheingau Musik Festival in Eberbach Abbey.

programme.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Música del Palacio de Minería in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are soprano Anabel de la Mora, tenor Andrés Carrillo and baritone Daniel Cerón.

programme.title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: The Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's landscape.

programme.title: Ravel - La Valse
programme.desc: For the Anniversary Gala, Cleveland Orchestra Music Director Franz Welser-Möst led a programme featuring pianist Lang Lang as soloist, offering works touching on more than a century of Viennese musical traditions.

programme.title: Beethoven, Symphony No. 4 in B flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Beethoven's Symphony No. 4 with the Deutsche Kammerphilharmonie Bremen conducted by Paavo Järvi.

programme.title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini's Violin Concerto No. 1 is paired with Brahms' dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No. 1.

programme.title: Beethoven, Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 8 with the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra conducted by Herbert von Karajan.

programme.title: Tribute to Hans van Manen
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognised as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity.

programme.title: Mahler: Symphony No.8
programme.desc: Gustavo Dudamel and his Simón Bolívar Symphony Orchestra perform Mahler to mark the highlight of the residency of El Sistema at the Salzburg Festival.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energising concert pieces featuring a range of artists.

programme.title: Berlioz : Symphonie fantastique, op. 14
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz's Symphonie fantastique, Op 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student.

programme.title: Beethoven: Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at the 2020 Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No 3 in E-flat major, Op 55, Eroica.

programme.title: Music in the Air
programme.desc: The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. Shedding light on the history of classical music. Featuring footage of Arturo Toscanini conducting the NBC Symphony Orchestra.

programme.title: Dvorák: Rusalka
programme.desc: Ádám Fisher conducts the orchestra and choir of La Monnaie in a performance of Antonín Dvorák's (1841-1904) Rusalka, a fairytale opera in three acts. Rusalka is the composer's ninth opera and still one of the cornerstones of Czech opera houses.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G Minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: The celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz presents Schumann's `Piano Sonata No 2 in G minor, Op. 22'. Of Schumann's three piano sonatas, it is the work performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energising concert pieces featuring a range of artists.

programme.title: Beethoven
programme.desc: Music publisher Anton Diabelli spent most of 1819 collecting money to help families that had lost their sons or fathers in the wars. He wrote a theme, hoping 51 composers would be willing to write variations to, with the intention of publishing.

programme.title: Works for Violin and Piano by Corelli, Ravel A.O
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform an intimate recital recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan. Featuring Arcangelo Corelli's 'Violin Sonata in D minor, Op. 5 No. 12, La Folia' and more.

programme.title: Liszt -- Elegies No. 1 and 2 (S. 130 & 131)
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Franz Liszt's 'Two Elegies for cello and piano', plus a recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Frédéric Chopin and Sergei Rachmaninoff.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: Traces the fascinating life of the German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck, she was an exceptional pianist who had a successful international music career. In 1840, she married Robert Schumann and eventually had eight children.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explores repertoire for piano and violin in the concert recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The 'Grande Dame' of the piano is joined by various renowned artists.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energising concert pieces featuring a range of artists.

programme.title: Clara Haskil : le mystère de l'interprète
programme.desc: Charlie Chaplin considered her a genius. Clara Haskil was undeniably a brilliant pianist, an enchanting, fluid, poetic performer able to captivate an audience like no other artist.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Sonata for Cello, Op. 19
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Sergei Rachmaninoff's Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy.

programme.title: Heyward conducts Dvorák's Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvorák's Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, 'From the New World'. A melodic masterpiece, it remains a popular symphony.
